title: Specializations lift through a smooth presentation when the stack is quasi-compact above the point
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a specialisation of points of an algebraic stack lifts to a specialisation in any smooth presentation by an algebraic space, provided the pair (stack, point) satisfies the quasi-compactness condition on the fibre of the relation above the point (author lemma at source lines 10336-10346, label lemma-specialization). The proof (source lines 10348-10373) reduces the presentation to an affine scheme, chooses a point of it over the specialising point, uses the hypothesis to see that a fibre of the relation is quasi-compact, and shows by an openness argument that the given point lies in the closure of the image of the corresponding composite, so that the reach-points criterion produces the required specialisation (proof lines 10349-10372). The closure computation with its contrapositive openness argument is the content. H2.
